title: HarshitBilagi/Hybrid-Token-Efficient-Routing-Agent
summary: HarshitBilagi/Hybrid-Token-Efficient-Routing-Agent 是一个自主路由层，在推理时决定是否将查询发送到轻量级本地模型（Intel AI Boost NPU）或强大的远程 LLM（Groq/Fireworks AI），以优化令牌使用同时保持准确度。该项目作为受 AMD 开发者黑客马拉松 ACT II 问题启发的组合项目构建，采用 Python 语言实现。
description: An autonomous routing layer that decides at inference time whether to send a query to a lightweight local model (Intel AI Boost NPU) or a powerful remote LLM (Groq/Fireworks AI), optimizing for token usage while maintaining accuracy constraints.  Built as a portfolio project inspired by the AMD Deve
